name: MaxxOps
description: Searches the MaxxOps product catalog and reads or updates offer lines through dbAPI.

settings.label: API URL
settings.hint: Root that serves /data and /auth. Example: https://erp.example.com/api/v1

settings.label: Client token
settings.hint: API client token. Sent to /auth/client, not a MaxxOps username.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.hint: Secret issued with that client. The adapter keeps the access token until it expires.

settings.label: Company ID
settings.hint: Numeric id of the company whose catalog and offers are used.
